keyDates.text: TODAY: Comment period closes on Ed Dept's sweeping accreditation overhaul NPRM (AIM rulemaking). Final rule could take effect July 1, 2027.
FY2026 fiscal year ends. Unspent congressionally approved research funds revert to Treasury if agencies have not obligated them.
2027-28 FAFSA opens to all applicants at StudentAid.gov. Beta access has been available since early September.
Brown University Early Decision deadline for Class of 2031 applicants (11:59 p.m. local time).
Federal continuing resolution expires. Congress must pass FY2027 appropriations or another CR to avoid a government shutdown.
Regular Decision deadline for Harvard, Yale, Columbia, Penn, and most Ivy League schools (Class of 2031 cycle).
Brown University Regular Decision deadline for Class of 2031 applicants.
Ivy Day 2027 expected (late March). Regular Decision notifications released for the Class of 2031.
